study: NATVIEW new-site bounded external feasibility panel; implementation, not clinical validation
selection: prespecified evidence/NATVIEW_PROPOSED_8person_repeat_extension.json, modality/visit availability only; all8 retained in denominator
VU_literal_channels: case differences retained in source; final two VU positions literally TP9-prime and TP10-prime, always interpolated at source directions

bridge.base: drop VU F4/FT9/FT10 feature positions; retain existing VU reference
bridge.additional_missing_policy: up to3 of21 exact nonprime sites may be interpolated from >=40 measured scalp donors; two prime sites always interpolated
bridge.geometry: MNE accurate spherical spline using source NATVIEW donor and VU target direction vectors, normalized to95mm sphere, fixed origin0; explicit EEGLAB [X,Y,Z] to head [-Y,X,Z]; no outcome fitted geometry
bridge.direct_measured_vs_interpolated: report for each subject; do not call all23 commonly measured channels
bridge.reference: NATVIEW average over released retained scalp montage; VU SET ref=common; these remain a domain shift

VU_model.training_only: all29 existing VU scans; no ds006040 or NATVIEW training
VU_model.selector: per-target alpha retained from existing all26 VU cv_A geometric median across5 folds; NOT newly optimized for common23
VU_model.training_standardization: VU-only feature mean and sd+1e-8; no NATVIEW target-stat adaptation or calibration
VU_model.coefficient_finalization: bitwise unchanged coefficients/scalers; model channel metadata now literal prime labels

EEG_processing.units: EEGLAB native uV; assert MNE volts*1e6 agrees within1e-4uV; no /100 neural scaling
EEG_processing.identity: case-only canonicalization for NATVIEW, never replacement by another electrode
EEG_processing.sampling: 250to200Hz polyphase4/5 antialiasing separately within every physical segment
EEG_processing.filter: MNE0.5Hz highpass zero phase separately within segment; 5s margins around 24s context
EEG_processing.features: original baseline_ridge.band_power_features,44 one-Hz bins1..45Hz,12x2s lags oldestfirst, Welch nperseg200, log(power+1e-12)
EEG_processing.window: 4801samples including trigger for baseline mean; crop last sample to4800 as existing VU helper

clock.identity: same ordered raw R128 and event->urevent physical volume identities
clock.certificate: all surviving anchors must have monotonic, exact integer original-minus-processed offsets; same-offset bracketing anchors certify physical time; split at every source boundary; no extrapolation; original24s+5s margins and min60 retained
clock.source_mask: retained unchanged as stage-specific/possibly noncumulative provenance; never silently expanded or used as cumulative timeline
clock.independent_clocks: original numeric gates unchanged: raw TR6ms, raw/urevent4.1ms, eye unique>=90% within50ms, BIOPAC count and relative40ms
clock.no_outcome_alignment: no BOLD values/predictions/correlations used in amendment or sample map

exclusions.window: reject any24s physical history plus original5s margins not fully bracketed by equal-offset event anchors within one source-boundary-free segment; no extrapolation
exclusions.motion: AFNI6 param Power FD50mm radius; FD>0.5mm and following frame excluded
exclusions.channel: exclude if >3 of21 nonprime sites absent or <40 measured donors with finite source coordinates
exclusions.person: minimum60 target frames (126s retained target duration), finite EEG/targets, all timing requirements; preserve failed-person denominator
exclusions.strict_measured_comparison: report measured nonprime coverage and interpolation counts; two VU prime sites are always interpolated, so no all23-measured claim; no choosing analysis by predictive scores

targets.regions: NiftiMapsMasker DiFuMo64 maps resampled in world coordinates to released MNI3mm image; VU label identity/order checks
targets.global: mean of released MNI nonzero temporal support (sd>1e-8); native EPI mask not treated as MNI mask
targets.released_processing: noGSR/no temporal filter/sm0; CCS motion24 +WM/CSF; no additional fitted nuisance regression
targets.postprocessing: 5th order0.15Hz Butterworth filtfilt; full-run demean/absolute95thpercentile normalization
targets.differences: NATVIEW CCS MNI152Lin vs existing VU derivative, distinct global-mask/reference/cleaning; common labels do not establish identical preprocessing

endpoints.primary: unshifted temporal r globally and arithmetic mean over64 regions, per person then equally over people
endpoints.amplitude: normalized-target predictiveR2 and std(prediction)/std(target); no test calibration
endpoints.residual: regional and predicted global residualization using one VU-trained coefficient per region; no measured global model input
endpoints.lag: diagnostic -5..5 original volume indices, positive prediction later, minimum20 pairs; never changes primary alignment
endpoints.CI: 2000 within-person stationary block bootstrap, expected10TR/21s block, restart at gaps;10000 between-person resamples, seed20261021

physiology.role: independent timing/coverage QC only in this bounded test; pupil area not calibrated, respiration inV, no clinical arousal or sleep diagnosis
physiology.pilot_eye: 285pulses map volumes1..285; missing0/286/287;76.4% interpolated; Time is quantized, so no pupil-BOLD association claim

causal_context: features have declared physical past context; source artifact/ICA correction, zero-phase filtering, interpolation and whole-run targets are retrospective
license: NKI NATVIEW data/code CC BY4.0; preserve source attribution and SHA256 receipts; no redistribution of raw arrays

scope: secondary exploratory amended metadata adapter; NOT original untouched confirmation
original_v1_result: 7/8 excluded by source-mask contract; only sub12 eligible. Preserved under v1/.
amendment: use exact event/urevent sample-offset certificates rather than assuming source clean_sample_mask is cumulative; no source field overwritten
v2_clock_policy: all surviving anchors must have monotonic, exact integer original-minus-processed offsets; same-offset bracketing anchors certify physical time; split at every source boundary; no extrapolation; original24s+5s margins and min60 retained
model_coefficients_scalers_and_bridge: unchanged from v1 final dd9b894b model and fixed VU/NATVIEW source coordinate bridge

original_v1_clock_contract.source: raw ordered R128 are volume0..N-1; processed event->urevent links identify original volume
original_v1_clock_contract.requirements: n_raw_R128=n_urevent_R128=n_BOLD; raw TR max deviation<=6ms; raw/urevent offset residual<=4.1ms
original_v1_clock_contract.mask: clean_sample_mask true count=pnts; all surviving event anchors agree within1.01 samples; each interior mask gap has boundary at compressed location
original_v1_clock_contract.boundary_duration_discrepancy: preserve source duration and exact mask gap length side by side; mask controls timing only after all anchor checks pass
original_v1_clock_contract.eye: Time column already task-relative; do NOT add StartTime; >=90% volume pulses with unique nearest raw event within50ms
original_v1_clock_contract.BIOPAC: sparse positive-code sample list; group samples within100ms; n_pulses=n_BOLD, relative first-pulse residual<=40ms
original_v1_clock_contract.volume_dropping: zero as pinned CCS wrapper numDropping=0 and verified pilot raw/processed header counts
original_v1_clock_contract.no_prediction_alignment: no offset, drift, lag or participant selection based on predicted/measured BOLD correlation
